description: A singer in a sparkling black sequined evening gown with a pearl necklace performs at a stand microphone, arms spread wide mid-song, smiling — the showpiece frame of the club folder. Behind her, a drummer in a blue floral shirt plays a pearl-finish kit; guitars, a cello or bass case, and two amplifiers (one Gibson-branded) crowd the small stage. The audience — soldiers in fatigues with visible tapes and chevrons, a few men in civilian shirts, one woman in a purple top at the rear — fills the room to the back wall. Two blond crew-cut heads in the foreground watch from the front row (one possibly Larry, back of head). Pink and blue wall lamps, woven ceiling, sheet backdrops.
